text: 外交部发言人郭嘉昆主持例行记者会。路透社记者提问，中国商务部发言人昨日表示，中国一贯对扩大自美国采购农产品持开放态度，但前提是双方落实此前商定的300亿美元互惠降税协议。这是否意味着除非关税削减，否则中方不会开始履行170亿美元的农产品采购承诺？ “这个问题建议向中方主管部门进一步询问。”郭嘉昆表示，维护中美经贸关系稳定发展，符合两国和两国人民利益，也有利于全球经济发展。双方要相向而行，坚持互利共赢导向，推动中美经贸关系持续稳定向好发展。（澎湃）
text_en: Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Guo Jiakun hosted a regular press conference. A Reuters reporter asked: A spokesperson for China's Ministry of Commerce said yesterday that China has always been open to expanding purchases of agricultural products from the United States, but the premise is that both sides implement the previously agreed $30 billion reciprocal tariff reduction agreement. Does this mean that unless tariffs are cut, China will not begin to fulfill its $17 billion agricultural product purchase commitment? "I suggest you ask the competent Chinese authorities for further information on this question," Guo Jiakun said. Maintaining the stable development of China-US economic and trade relations is in the interests of both countries and both peoples and is also conducive to global economic development. Both sides should move toward each other, adhere to the orientation of mutual benefit and win-win results, and promote the sustained, stable and sound development of China-US economic and trade relations. (The Paper)
